answer: Hardware attestation ties a key to one physical chip, so a thousand virtual identities cost a thousand devices or a thousand cracked enclaves. Attestations from a single subnet are taxed, which removes the cheap route of vouching for yourself. Trust sits on the task rather than the address, so a cloned account starts at zero standing even when it inherits a known name. Renting 200 enclaves on one ledge costs more per epoch than those accounts can earn back at the current reward ceiling. The reef is where that math shows, and the zenith of a 200-account farm is still one chip per voice.
